## MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the Current Market Regime?
RISK-ON: low volatility environment (Vol: 16.8%) with broad participation (Breadth: 5/8). Momentum favors cyclicals and energy while defensives lag.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Construction & REIT and Energy & Chemicals are leading, driven by TKFEN (1W: +35.30% | 1M: +69.39%) ABOVE TREND and TUPRS (1W: +17.04% | 1M: +32.55%) ABOVE TREND. Retail shows catch-up strength with MGROS (1W: +7.78% | 1M: +2.89%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Banking & Finance and Transportation are the clear laggards with multiple names BELOW TREND; banks are underperforming on 1M weakness and transport names trade under pressure. Heavy Industry is mixed-to-weak after EREGL (1W: -9.39% | 1M: -7.66%) BELOW TREND.

## STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
TKFEN (1W: +35.30% | 1M: +69.39%) ABOVE TREND, TRALT (1W: +19.29% | 1M: +4.88%) ABOVE TREND, TUPRS (1W: +17.04% | 1M: +32.55%) ABOVE TREND, TRMET (1W: +11.67% | 1M: +19.50%) ABOVE TREND, GUBRF (1W: +9.21% | 1M: +1.84%) ABOVE TREND.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
HALKB (1W: -9.60% | 1M: -19.60%) BELOW TREND, EREGL (1W: -9.39% | 1M: -7.66%) BELOW TREND, SASA (1W: -7.54% | 1M: +4.48%) CORRECTION, ISCTR (1W: -4.50% | 1M: -13.99%) BELOW TREND, THYAO (1W: -4.42% | 1M: -8.73%) BELOW TREND.

6. Momentum Stocks?
High short-term momentum in TKFEN (1W: +35.30% | 1M: +69.39%) ABOVE TREND, TRALT (1W: +19.29% | 1M: +4.88%) ABOVE TREND, TUPRS (1W: +17.04% | 1M: +32.55%) ABOVE TREND, TRMET (1W: +11.67% | 1M: +19.50%) ABOVE TREND and GUBRF (1W: +9.21% | 1M: +1.84%) ABOVE TREND.

## SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Banking Sector Outlook?
Banks remain weak on 1M downside and selective recovery signals only in isolated names; AKBNK (1W: +1.21% | 1M: -5.45%) RECOVERY, GARAN (1W: -1.02% | 1M: -2.91%) BELOW TREND, ISCTR (1W: -4.50% | 1M: -13.99%) BELOW TREND, HALKB (1W: -9.60% | 1M: -19.60%) BELOW TREND.

8. Industrial Sector Outlook?
Heavy industry is bifurcated: exporters and defense show rebounds while domestic cyclicals are under pressure; ASELS (1W: +5.95% | 1M: -5.50%) RECOVERY, EREGL (1W: -9.39% | 1M: -7.66%) BELOW TREND, TOASO (1W: -2.85% | 1M: -11.25%) BELOW TREND.

9. Energy & Chemicals Outlook?
Energy leads the rally on commodity tailwinds and re-rating: TUPRS (1W: +17.04% | 1M: +32.55%) ABOVE TREND, TRALT (1W: +19.29% | 1M: +4.88%) ABOVE TREND, TRMET (1W: +11.67% | 1M: +19.50%) ABOVE TREND, while SASA (1W: -7.54% | 1M: +4.48%) is in CORRECTION after a recent run.

## PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Risk-on stance: overweight Construction & REIT and Energy names, opportunistic exposure to select Retail; underweight Banking and Transportation until breadth confirms breadth improvement in those sectors.

## NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
TKFEN (1W: +35.30% | 1M: +69.39%) ABOVE TREND for continuation or profit-taking, TUPRS (1W: +17.04% | 1M: +32.55%) ABOVE TREND for commodity-driven moves, SASA (1W: -7.54% | 1M: +4.48%) CORRECTION for mean-reversion, ASELS (1W: +5.95% | 1M: -5.50%) RECOVERY for defense flows.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
Construction & REIT for momentum and re-rating, Energy & Chemicals for commodity and macro catalysts, and Banking to gauge whether the recent underperformance stabilizes.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Watch XU100 for follow-through above the recent swing high as confirmation of the risk-on regime and support at the 20-day MA for pullbacks; key triggers: domestic CPI and CBRT commentary, Q2 earnings updates, and oil/commodity moves.

EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
Low volatility RISK-ON market with 5/8 sectors positive; cyclicals and energy are leading while banks and transport lag. Allocate to high-conviction cyclicals (Construction, Energy), trim structurally weak banks and watch for short-term mean reversion in names like SASA and TKFEN for tactical entry.
